description: Node 24 + TypeScript service/bot (Discord, Twitch, CLI). tsx, vitest, eslint, prettier, Docker, CI.
install: npm install --save-dev typescript tsx vitest eslint '@eslint/js' typescript-eslint prettier '@types/node'
notes: Add your client library, e.g. npm install discord.js or @twurple/auth @twurple/chat.
Copy .env.example to .env and fill in BOT_TOKEN, then npm run dev.
